svg.text: Proposal C — Activity brush: drag a range over your own session density
The custom range is picked on the data, not on an abstract grid · popover width unchanged from the preset list (260 px)
① Today — two GtkCalendar, drawn to scale
Choose a start and end date to apply a custom range
560 px as drawn · 622 px measured — set by the 10% path, paid on every open
Two grids, 84 tappable day cells, zero indication of which days actually hold sessions.
GtkCalendar cannot highlight a span, so the selected range is invisible — only the info label states it.
② Proposal — same popover, one 236×56 strip
260 px — the preset list dictates the width, in every state
you cannot brush a range with
no sessions in it by accident.
③ Strip anatomy (zoomed) — GtkDrawingArea + GtkGestureDrag, 48 weekly buckets
Drag a handle → adjust one end.
Click a single bucket → that week.
a11y: needs a text fallback (see cons).
